fusions.name: Inkblot Jab
fusions.desc: Lashes out with ink that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 30% chance of [Blunted] for 6 seconds, lowering its critical hit chance. Each hit also has a 20% chance to confuse the target for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Eightfold Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes in every direction, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Each hit has a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed the Snare
fusions.desc: Removes two conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Reserve Arms
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 3 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your dodge chance is also 5% higher at all times.
